warnings.title: The staff have noticed you
warnings.text: Word is going round the staff room about you.

warnings.title: The staff are getting organised
warnings.text: Keep this up and they will come for your base.

messages.title: Base raid
messages.booked: The staff are raiding your base in {Time}. Be at your bed to defend it.
messages.reminder: The staff raid your base in {Time}.
messages.started: The staff are attacking your base. Kill them all.
messages.left_area: You left your base. Get back within {Time} or the raid is lost.
messages.won: You held your base. The staff will leave you alone for a day.
messages.lost_left: You abandoned your base. The raid is lost.
messages.lost_time: The staff gave up for now. They will be back.
messages.missed: The staff raided your base while you were away.
messages.missed_no_bed: The staff came looking for you, but you have no bed to defend.
